text:
```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      id: buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v1

    - name: Login to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v1
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

    - name: Run Clang Static Analyzer
      run: |
        docker run --rm \
          -v $(pwd):/src \
          -w /src \
          -e ANALYZE_ONLY=true \
          rsyslog/rsyslog-devcontainer:latest \
          make analyze

    - name: Upload scan-build HTML reports as artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: clang-analysis-report
        path: analysis/report.html
        retention-days: 7

    - name: Log artifact URL
      run: |
        echo "::set-output name=artifact_url::https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts/${{ env.ARTIFACT_ID }}"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a job to run the Clang static analyzer in a development container when a pull request is opened against the `main` branch of the `rsyslog/rsyslog` repository. The results are uploaded as an artifact, which can be accessed for up to seven days. The artifact URL is also logged for easy access.
